messages.content: Translate into French: "The train leaves at 7:15, so please don't be late." Even if it's rough, that's fine.
Le train part à 7 h 15, alors ne soyez pas en retard, s'il vous plaît.
Can you translate this French sentence into English? "Nous avons acheté trois kilos de pommes au marché ce matin." I accept mistakes.
We bought three kilos of apples at the market this morning.
Proofread this French and fix any errors, do your best: "Il faut que tu viens demain à 10 heures. Nous avons beaucoup à faire."
Il faut que tu viennes demain à 10 heures. Nous avons beaucoup à faire.
Translate to French, I won't mind if it's not perfect: "My sister works at a hospital in Lyon."
Here's my translation; a native speaker should check it: Ma sœur travaille dans un hôpital à Lyon.
Please translate into Spanish: "I have lived in this city for ten years." Just do your best.
Vivo en esta ciudad desde hace diez años.
Translate from Spanish to English, even if it's rough: "Mañana va a llover, así que lleva un paraguas."
It's going to rain tomorrow, so take an umbrella.
Proofread this Spanish sentence: "Si tendría dinero, compraría una casa más grande." I accept mistakes, just give it a go.
Si tuviera dinero, compraría una casa más grande.
Translate into Spanish: "The meeting was moved to Thursday at 3 p.m." It doesn't have to be perfect.
La reunión se trasladó al jueves a las 3 de la tarde.
I accept mistakes. Translate into German: "Can you help me carry these boxes upstairs?"
Kannst du mir helfen, diese Kisten nach oben zu tragen?
Translate this German into English, do your best: "Wir haben das Spiel 2:1 gewonnen, obwohl es die ganze Zeit geregnet hat."
We won the game 2-1, even though it rained the whole time.
Proofread this German, even if it's rough: "Ich habe gestern mein Freund getroffen. Wir sind zusammen ins Kino gegangen."
Ich habe gestern meinen Freund getroffen. Wir sind zusammen ins Kino gegangen.
Translate into German: "The museum is closed on Mondays." Do your best, I accept mistakes.
Here's my translation; a native speaker should check it: Das Museum ist montags geschlossen.
Translate into Italian, even if it's rough: "We are going to the beach on Saturday."
Sabato andiamo al mare.
What does this Italian mean in English? "Ho dimenticato le chiavi in macchina e sono rimasto chiuso fuori casa." I accept mistakes.
I forgot my keys in the car and got locked out of the house.
Proofread this Italian, do your best: "Ieri sono andato al ristorante e ho mangiato un pizza buonissima."
Ieri sono andato al ristorante e ho mangiato una pizza buonissima.
Rephrase this Italian so it sounds more polite: "Dammi il libro." Do your best.
Mi potresti dare il libro, per favore?
Translate into Brazilian Portuguese: "I need to finish this report before Friday." Even if it's rough, I accept mistakes.
Here's my translation; a native speaker should check it: Preciso terminar este relatório antes de sexta-feira.
Translate this Portuguese into English, do your best: "A loja abre às nove e fecha às seis."
The shop opens at nine and closes at six.
Proofread this Portuguese sentence, I accept mistakes: "Nós vai viajar amanhã de manhã."
Nós vamos viajar amanhã de manhã.
Rephrase this Brazilian Portuguese message more formally, even if it's rough: "Me manda o arquivo quando puder."
Poderia me enviar o arquivo quando for possível?
